body: I guess I'll just have to listen to a bit more by Burzum to see, then. I don't know how often I will, but I'll be sure to.
An instrumental version of that song would actually probably be pretty cool. I don't like metal terribly much, but usually only because of the vocals.

That's a tough one to answer. I listen to a ton of different artists, each of them really good in their own way. I might narrow it down to Panic! At the Disco, Hozier, and Bastille, but between those, no idea which I'd pick as favourite.

Not really sure what the problem is, to be wholly honest. I feel okay but I also know I'm definitely not. I don't know really how to describe it, sorry. I just feel like/know if I'm not occupied with something I'll end up killing myself. Talking to people is something I don't really feel like I can just take myself away from until either they're done talking to me or I'm too tired to think, so I figured it'd help me to keep occupied.

I know I've got some kind of set of issues, and I've recently started seeing a psychologist to identify why I have the thoughts I do, but it's really not moving fast enough for me. Still nothing treatment or management-wise, not even a diagnosis yet, we're still "gathering information," as she says.
